name: ms4-mcp-server
description: Machine Spirit 4 fused runtime MCP surface: identity, ethics, fused chat, voice readiness, model view, doctrine grounding, HiveMind inventory, local-image VLM analysis, Nibbles dry-run validation, full Hermes tool access, dependency/capability status, Hermes auto-update, Double Agent foreground/background coordination, and Windows desktop UI control.

tools.name: ms4.vision.analyze_local@v1
tools.description: Analyze a validated local image file through a HiveMind VLM.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.tool.call@v1
tools.description: Dispatch any available Hermes tool through MS4.

tools.name: ms4.runtime.deps.status@v1
tools.description: Report contained MS4 runtime dependency and capability status.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.version@v1
tools.description: Current vs latest Hermes version via public GitHub releases (cached ~1h).

tools.name: ms4.hermes.releases@v1
tools.description: Recent Hermes releases for the pin-a-version selector.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update@v1
tools.description: Trigger an idempotent in-place Hermes upgrade (editable git checkout or PyPI wheel) in the MS4 contained .venv.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update.status@v1
tools.description: Current/last Hermes upgrade phase and progress trail.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.submit@v1
tools.description: Submit a Double Agent background job (foreground/background lobe coordination).

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.status@v1
tools.description: Current snapshot for one Double Agent job, including is_stale and last_safe_user_status.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.list@v1
tools.description: List Double Agent jobs filtered by conversation_id and state.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.events@v1
tools.description: Recent allowlisted lifecycle events for a job. Anti-hallucination: no raw model tokens.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.cancel@v1
tools.description: Cancel a running Double Agent job.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.mark_stale@v1
tools.description: Mark a Double Agent job stale and signal the worker to stop.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.status@v1
tools.description: Report Windows desktop-control readiness and active screen/window context.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.capture@v1
tools.description: Capture desktop screenshot metadata and optionally a base64 image.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.action@v1
tools.description: Perform local desktop UI actions through MS4.
